// RealWorld backend data model.
// See https://realworld-docs.netlify.app/specifications/backend/endpoints/

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output   = "../src/generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  email     String   @unique
  username  String   @unique
  password  String
  bio       String?
  image     String?

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Runs the vendored RealWorld Hurl collection against a running server.
#
#   npm run test:api                 # start a server on a free port, run all 13 files
#   HOST=http://localhost:8000 \
#     npm run test:api               # run against an already-running server
#   npm run test:api -- auth.hurl    # run a subset
#
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
HURL_DIR="$ROOT/tests/hurl"
PORT="${PORT:-8000}"
HOST="${HOST:-}"
UID_VAL="${UID_VAL:-$(date +%s)$$}"

FILES=()
for arg in "$@"; do
  if [[ -f "$arg" ]]; then FILES+=("$arg"); else FILES+=("$HURL_DIR/$arg"); fi
done
if [ ${#FILES[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
  FILES=("$HURL_DIR"/*.hurl)
fi

SERVER_PID=""
cleanup() {
  if [[ -n "$SERVER_PID" ]] && kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [[ -z "$HOST" ]]; then
  HOST="http://localhost:$PORT"
  echo "Starting server on $HOST"
  (cd "$ROOT" && PORT="$PORT" LOG_LEVEL="${LOG_LEVEL:-warn}" npx tsx src/server.ts) &
  SERVER_PID=$!

  for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
    if curl -fsS "$HOST/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  curl -fsS "$HOST/health" >/dev/null || { echo "Server did not become ready at $HOST"; exit 1; }
fi

echo "Running Hurl tests against $HOST with uid=$UID_VAL"
hurl --test \
  --jobs 1 \
  --variable "host=$HOST" \
  --variable "uid=$UID_VAL" \
  "${FILES[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Runs the vendored RealWorld Hurl collection against a running server.
#
#   npm run test:api                 # start a server on a free port, run all 13 files
#   HOST=http://localhost:8000 \
#     npm run test:api               # run against an already-running server
#   npm run test:api -- auth.hurl    # run a subset
#
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
HURL_DIR="$ROOT/tests/hurl"
PORT="${PORT:-8000}"
HOST="${HOST:-}"
UID_VAL="${UID_VAL:-$(date +%s)$$}"

FILES=()
for arg in "$@"; do
  if [[ -f "$arg" ]]; then FILES+=("$arg"); else FILES+=("$HURL_DIR/$arg"); fi
done
if [ ${#FILES[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
  FILES=("$HURL_DIR"/*.hurl)
fi

SERVER_PID=""
cleanup() {
  if [[ -n "$SERVER_PID" ]] && kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [[ -z "$HOST" ]]; then
  HOST="http://localhost:$PORT"
  echo "Starting server on $HOST"
  (cd "$ROOT" && PORT="$PORT" LOG_LEVEL="${LOG_LEVEL:-warn}" npx tsx src/server.ts) &
  SERVER_PID=$!

  for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
    if curl -fsS "$HOST/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  curl -fsS "$HOST/health" >/dev/null || { echo "Server did not become ready at $HOST"; exit 1; }
fi

echo "Running Hurl tests against $HOST with uid=$UID_VAL"
hurl --test \
  --jobs 1 \
  --variable "host=$HOST" \
  --variable "uid=$UID_VAL" \
  "${FILES[@]}"

# RealWorld Backend — Fastify + Prisma + SQLite

A complete implementation of the [RealWorld ("Conduit") backend specification](https://realworld-docs.netlify.app/specifications/backend/endpoints/)
in TypeScript.

**Stack:** Node.js · TypeScript · [Fastify 5](https://fastify.dev) · [Prisma 7](https://www.prisma.io) · SQLite · JWT

## Quick start

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

`npm run dev` generates the Prisma client, syncs the SQLite schema and starts the API on
<http://localhost:8000> with file watching. No other setup step is required.

## Scripts

| Script | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run dev` | Generate client, sync schema, run the server with watch mode |
| `npm start` | Same, without watch mode |
| `npm run test:api` | Start a server and run the official RealWorld Hurl collection |
| `npm run typecheck` | `tsc --noEmit` |
| `npm run db:generate` | Regenerate the Prisma client |
| `npm run db:setup` | Push `prisma/schema.prisma` to the SQLite database |

## Configuration

Settings come from the environment (a `.env` file is loaded automatically).

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PORT` | `8000` | HTTP port |
| `HOST` | `0.0.0.0` | Bind address |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `file:./prisma/dev.db` | SQLite connection string |
| `JWT_SECRET` | `realworld-dev-secret` | Signing key — **override in production** |
| `JWT_EXPIRES_IN` | `7d` | Token lifetime |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | Pino log level |

## Testing

The [official Hurl collection](https://github.com/realworld-apps/realworld/tree/main/specs/api/hurl)
is vendored under `tests/hurl/` — 13 files, 154 requests. It requires
[Hurl](https://hurl.dev) on your `PATH`.

```bash
npm run test:api                    # boot a server, run everything
npm run test:api -- auth.hurl       # run a single file
HOST=http://localhost:8000 npm run test:api   # reuse a running server
```

Current status: **13/13 files, 154/154 requests passing.**

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Auth | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/api/users` | — | Register → `201` |
| `POST` | `/api/users/login` | — | Login |
| `GET` | `/api/user` | required | Current user |
| `PUT` | `/api/user` | required | Update current user |
| `GET` | `/api/profiles/:username` | optional | Profile |
| `POST` | `/api/profiles/:username/follow` | required | Follow |
| `DELETE` | `/api/profiles/:username/follow` | required | Unfollow |
| `GET` | `/api/articles` | optional | Filters: `tag`, `author`, `favorited`, `limit`, `offset` |
| `GET` | `/api/articles/feed` | required | Articles from followed authors |
| `POST` | `/api/articles` | required | Create → `201` |
| `GET` | `/api/articles/:slug` | optional | Single article |
| `PUT` | `/api/articles/:slug` | required | Update (author only) |
| `DELETE` | `/api/articles/:slug` | required | Delete (author only) → `204` |
| `POST` | `/api/articles/:slug/favorite` | required | Favorite |
| `DELETE` | `/api/articles/:slug/favorite` | required | Unfavorite |
| `GET` | `/api/articles/:slug/comments` | optional | List comments |
| `POST` | `/api/articles/:slug/comments` | required | Add comment → `201` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/articles/:slug/comments/:id` | required | Delete comment (author only) → `204` |
| `GET` | `/api/tags` | — | Tags in use |
| `GET` | `/health` | — | Liveness probe |

Authenticated requests carry `Authorization: Token <jwt>` (`Bearer` is also accepted).

## Behaviour notes

These are the spec details the Hurl suite pins down explicitly:

- **Errors** are always `{"errors": {"<field>": ["<message>"]}}`. Missing token → `401`
  `{"token": ["is missing"]}`; wrong owner → `403` `{"<resource>": ["forbidden"]}`;
  unknown resource → `404` `{"<resource>": ["not found"]}`; duplicate username/email →
  `409` `{"<field>": ["has already been taken"]}`; validation → `422`.
- **Nullable vs. required fields.** On `PUT /api/user`, `bio` and `image` accept `null`
  and normalize `""` to `null`; `username`, `email` and `password` reject both.
- **Passwords** follow NIST SP 800-63B 5.1.1.2: minimum 8 characters, at least 64
  accepted, no composition rules.
- **`tagList`** keeps its submitted order (a `position` column on the join table). Omitting
  it in an update preserves the existing tags, `[]` clears them, and `null` is rejected
  with `422`.
- **Slugs** are `slugified-title-<random>` so duplicate titles are allowed, and they stay
  stable across updates so existing links keep resolving.
- **`articlesCount`** is the total number of matching articles, independent of
  `limit`/`offset`.
- **`updatedAt`** is guaranteed to move forward on every article update, even when two
  writes land in the same millisecond.

prisma/schema.prisma   Data model (User, Follow, Article, Tag, ArticleTag, Comment, Favorite)
prisma.config.ts       Prisma 7 config (schema path + datasource URL)
src/app.ts             Fastify wiring: error handler, JSON parser, route registration
src/server.ts          Entry point
src/auth.ts            JWT signing/verification, password hashing, auth hooks
src/errors.ts          ApiError + spec-shaped error constructors
src/validation.ts      Field readers and the Rails-style validation messages
src/serializers.ts     Prisma includes and JSON response shapes
src/routes/            users, profiles, articles, comments, tags
tests/hurl/            Vendored official Hurl collection
tests/run-hurl-tests.sh
```
